n2bf52dc1cc.headline: Home mortgage approvals drop to lowest since December 2023
n2bf52dc1cc.summary: Mortgage approvals in the UK dropped to their lowest level since December 2023. Experts said the Middle East conflict pushing up borrowing costs weighed on buyer demand.
n2bf52dc1cc.why: Mortgage approvals are a leading indicator of UK housing activity and are sensitive to Bank of England rates and lending conditions.

n663bc084a9.headline: UAE property market picks up in UAE after a slowdown. What new report says
n663bc084a9.summary: The UAE property market is showing a positive outlook after a slowdown. The gap between what homebuyers expect to pay and sellers' asking prices has narrowed significantly.
n663bc084a9.why: Real estate is a major part of the UAE economy, and pricing trends affect developers, lenders and foreign investors.

n7a85a7f182.headline: Trump says the U.S. and Iran will meet in Qatar after weekend attacks
n7a85a7f182.summary: President Trump said talks with Iran would resume Tuesday in Qatar, despite the two sides trading attacks in the Gulf over the weekend. Iran did not confirm whether it will participate.
n7a85a7f182.why: Qatar hosts US-linked diplomacy and Gulf energy exports, and US-Iran tensions shape regional oil supply risk.

ne6e2fbb634.headline: First meeting of Iran-Oman joint committee on Strait of Hormuz convenes in Muscat
ne6e2fbb634.summary: The first meeting of the Iran-Oman joint committee on managing the Strait of Hormuz convened in Muscat, according to Iranian Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi.
ne6e2fbb634.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a major oil transit route, so management arrangements between littoral states affect energy shipping.

n0673bbb17d.headline: Delhi EV Policy: Zero road tax on cars under ₹30 lakh, ₹1 lakh scrappage bonus and ICE phase-out dates unveiled
n0673bbb17d.summary: Delhi has unveiled a new EV policy with zero road tax on cars under ₹30 lakh, a ₹1 lakh scrappage bonus, tiered subsidies and possible ICE registration curbs for 2027–28.
n0673bbb17d.why: Electric-vehicle incentives and ICE phase-out plans shape demand for EVs, charging infrastructure and conventional car sales in India's largest city market.

neecf3d7233.headline: U.S. And Iran Set To Meet Tuesday In Qatar For Talks
neecf3d7233.summary: The US and Iran have paused attacks after a tense weekend, with talks set for Tuesday in Qatar. The focus is the Strait of Hormuz and rising oil prices.
neecf3d7233.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of seaborne oil, so any disruption there moves global crude prices and energy-linked equities.
neecf3d7233.why_moved: Talks on the Strait of Hormuz and a pause in attacks are the input facts behind expectations of easing supply risk.

n4072a2b56e.headline: Porsche liquidates regional dealer channels as retail losses reach 4413 USD per car in China
n4072a2b56e.summary: Porsche is terminating vehicle sales authorisations across four Chinese cities after a global profit drop. The article reports retail losses of $4,413 per car in China.
n4072a2b56e.why: Porsche is a German luxury carmaker, and China is a significant market for its vehicles and profits.

nc3f876b7df.headline: Iran war has cost Americans $1,000 per household, economist estimates
nc3f876b7df.summary: Moody's Analytics chief economist Mark Zandi estimates the Iran war has cost Americans roughly $1,000 per household in higher fuel, food and other expenses since February.
nc3f876b7df.why: Higher energy and food prices feed into US inflation and consumer spending, which shape Federal Reserve policy and corporate earnings.

n79deac473c.headline: Why Rocket Lab Stock Went to the Moon Today
n79deac473c.summary: Rocket Lab shares rose sharply after the company issued what was described as a direct challenge to SpaceX's space supremacy.
n79deac473c.why: Rocket Lab is a US space launch and satellite company, and its competitive position against SpaceX affects valuations across the commercial space sector.

n177c3e1a92.headline: US, Iran negotiators head to Doha, but meeting uncertain
n177c3e1a92.summary: US negotiators, including Jared Kushner and envoy Steve Witkoff, are heading to Doha for talks with Iran. The source says the meeting's outcome is uncertain.
n177c3e1a92.why: US-Iran diplomacy affects Middle East security, oil supply expectations and risk sentiment across global markets.

n02b50fd993.headline: Food delivery, travel bookings and Tencent boost Prosus profit
n02b50fd993.summary: Prosus reported higher profit driven by food delivery, travel bookings and its Tencent holding. It cited strong contributions from iFood in Latin America and growth at OLX in Europe.
n02b50fd993.why: Prosus is a large Dutch investment group with stakes in global internet businesses and a major holding in Tencent.

impacts.name: Prosus
impacts.why: The results report higher profit from several of its businesses.

n10b958eb3e.headline: EU, China Trade Tensions Loom over Minister Visit
n10b958eb3e.summary: EU trade chief Maros Sefcovic hosts Chinese counterpart Wang Wentao in Brussels for talks on trade frictions. Brussels is concerned about increasing trade imbalances between the EU and China.
n10b958eb3e.why: EU-China trade relations affect tariffs, supply chains and export access for many listed European and Chinese companies. Trade disputes can shift sector earnings outlooks.

nb444247e9c.headline: Energy bill cap 'won't go up in October' but you will pay much more
nb444247e9c.summary: The energy bill cap will not go up in October, but households will still pay much more. The news comes ahead of a large jump in gas and electricity bills expected this week.
nb444247e9c.why: The UK energy price cap sets the maximum unit rates suppliers can charge households, linking retail energy costs to wholesale gas and power prices. Changes affect inflation and consumer spending.

nd6736236fb.headline: Trump says Doha talks on Tuesday amid Iran
nd6736236fb.summary: Trump said Iran requested a meeting after recent military escalation over the Strait of Hormuz and that talks would take place in Doha on Tuesday. Iranian officials said no technical meetings were scheduled this week.
nd6736236fb.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key chokepoint for seaborne oil shipments, so tensions there directly affect global crude supply and prices. Qatar hosts major US military and diplomatic presence and is a major LNG exporter.

nf6dc07575b.headline: Govt hands over PIA control to new owner following successful first financial closing
nf6dc07575b.summary: The Privatisation Commission of Pakistan completed the first closing of the PIA sale and received Rs10 billion in initial proceeds. A second closing is scheduled within 12 months.
nf6dc07575b.why: Pakistan International Airlines is the national carrier, and its privatisation is part of the government's effort to reduce state losses and attract foreign capital.

nf20a4d515d.headline: Oman studies first pumped hydro energy project
nf20a4d515d.summary: Oman's power sector authorities are studying the feasibility of developing the sultanate's first pumped hydro energy storage project. The study is at a feasibility stage.
nf20a4d515d.why: Pumped hydro storage helps balance electricity grids with variable renewable output, and is a long-duration storage option for power utilities.

n1cdf6c07cd.headline: Stocks and Oil Prices Rise with Eyes on Iran; Yen Touches 40-Year Low vs Dollar
n1cdf6c07cd.summary: The yen touched a 40-year low against the dollar, while US crude rose 2.2% to $70.75 a barrel on Iran concerns. Gold is on track for its steepest quarterly drop since 2013.
n1cdf6c07cd.why: The yen's weakness reflects its role as a funding currency and interest-rate differentials, while crude and gold are key inflation and safe-haven benchmarks for investors.
n1cdf6c07cd.why_moved: Oil rose on Iran-related concerns, the yen weakened to a 40-year low against the dollar, and gold was set for its steepest quarterly fall since 2013.

n5672b47202.headline: AI chip rally faces reality check, but bubble fears may be overdone: Adrian Mowat
n5672b47202.summary: EM-Equity Strategist Adrian Mowat says South Korean chip stocks are seeing a temporary dip rather than an AI bubble bursting. He attributes the volatility to strong earnings revisions driven by tight supply and demand.
n5672b47202.why: South Korea's chipmakers are major producers of memory chips used in AI servers, so their share prices reflect global AI demand.

n2d504b9ef0.headline: Cellid Crashes After-Hours on Phase 3 Failure...Shaperon Dives 25%[K-bio pulse]
n2d504b9ef0.summary: Cellid shares crashed after hours on a Phase 3 trial failure, according to the report. Shaperon shares dived 25% in the same session.
n2d504b9ef0.why: Phase 3 trials are the final clinical stage before drug approval, so their outcomes strongly move the valuations of small biotech companies.

n194a840325.headline: World Bank abandons goal to climate change projects
n194a840325.summary: The World Bank has abandoned its climate lending target adopted in 2023 during the Biden administration, according to a report.
n194a840325.why: The World Bank is a major multilateral lender whose financing priorities affect infrastructure and energy projects in developing economies.

nbca6dd5bac.headline: BSP pushes AI governance framework for financial stability
nbca6dd5bac.summary: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas is urging banks and nonbanks to build artificial intelligence governance frameworks. It cites risks including data privacy, bias and reputational damage.
nbca6dd5bac.why: The Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas is the Philippines' central bank and financial regulator. Its supervisory guidance shapes how lenders deploy technology and manage risk.

n7a59572177.headline: Smallholder interest stays at 6% despite BI Rate hike: Hartarto
n7a59572177.summary: Coordinating Economic Affairs Minister Airlangga Hartarto said the smallholder interest rate will stay at 6% despite the BI Rate increase. The statement was reported by Antara News.
n7a59572177.why: Bank Indonesia sets the benchmark policy rate, which influences rupiah yields and borrowing costs. Subsidised smallholder lending is a government programme separate from the policy rate.

n326c9a91de.headline: Why Sandisk Stock Just Dropped
n326c9a91de.summary: Sandisk shares dropped after a report raised the question of whether cheap Chinese chips could take market share and profits from the company. The report was published by The Motley Fool.
n326c9a91de.why: Sandisk is a US maker of flash memory and storage products, a cyclical business sensitive to pricing. Competition from lower-cost suppliers can pressure margins.
n326c9a91de.why_moved: Investors reacted to concern that cheap Chinese chips could take market share and profits from Sandisk, according to the report.

n88a1f229ca.headline: Philippines targets completion of Japan trade pact by November
n88a1f229ca.summary: The Philippines aims to conclude the review of its free trade agreement with Japan in November this year, according to the Department of Trade and Industry.
n88a1f229ca.why: Free trade agreements set tariff and investment terms between countries, affecting trade flows for exporters and importers.

n44d19e1144.headline: Iran says only it can clear Hormuz mines
n44d19e1144.summary: Iran said only its forces would be responsible for clearing mines from the Strait of Hormuz under the Islamabad memorandum of understanding.
n44d19e1144.why: The Strait of Hormuz is a key chokepoint for global oil shipments, so any disruption there affects crude supply and freight costs.

n84dfa07737.headline: Alphabet debuts in Dow Jones Industrial Average as index tilts toward tech
n84dfa07737.summary: Alphabet shares rose on Monday as the Google parent debuted in the Dow Jones Industrial Average, replacing Verizon Communications. The change tilts the blue-chip index toward technology.
n84dfa07737.why: The Dow Jones Industrial Average is a price-weighted index of 30 large US companies, and index changes can drive passive fund rebalancing.

impacts.name: Alphabet
impacts.why: Alphabet shares climbed after its addition to the Dow.

n943f2ab86e.headline: JPMorgan Maintains Overweight Rating on Aura Minerals (AUGO)
n943f2ab86e.summary: JPMorgan kept an overweight rating on Aura Minerals Inc. but lowered its price target from $112 to $104.50 after updating its financial model.
n943f2ab86e.why: Aura Minerals is a notable mining company; analyst ratings influence investor sentiment and stock performance.

nee05d4584c.headline: Bitdeer Technologies Group Signs Colocation Lease Agreement for Tydal, Norway AI Data Center Site
nee05d4584c.summary: Bitdeer Technologies Group signed a colocation lease agreement for the Tydal AI data center site in Norway to expand its infrastructure.
nee05d4584c.why: Data center expansion reflects growing demand for AI computing power and infrastructure investment in technology sectors.
